paper_title: Wenn mehr gearbeitet würde – Potenziale des deutschen Arbeitsmarktes
caption: Arbeitszeiten von Frauen mit und ohne Kinder
model_annotation: The diagram presents the distribution of working hours per week among women with and without children under 14 in the household, with the x-axis representing the number of hours worked per week, ranging from "bis 9" to "50 und mehr" in non-numerical, irregular intervals, and the y-axis labeled "Anteil in %" (percentage share) with a linear scale from 0 to 40 in increments of 10. The two lines in the graph represent women with children under 14 in the household (lighter blue, solid line) and those without (darker blue, solid line). The line for women with children under 14 starts at around 7% for "bis 9" hours, peaks at approximately 20% for "20 bis 24" hours, and then declines to around 3% for "50 und mehr" hours. The line for women without children under 14 begins at around 6% for "bis 9" hours, remains relatively stable until "30 bis 34" hours where it is around 10%, and then increases to a peak of about 30% for "45 bis 49" hours before dropping to around 2% for "50 und mehr" hours.
